description: The editor performance floor's line-fixture generator and p95 rank rule, in the desktop Playwright harness (TypeScript) and in the device runner (plain node .mjs, imported by tests/android-editor-perf.mjs over CDP). The copy exists because the device leg cannot import the harness's TS; it matters because device and desktop numbers are only comparable if both open the SAME document and rank samples the same way. Locked by a differential assertion in tests/lib/editorDevicePerf.test.mjs.
